beschreibung:
Motorcycle Legends at Over 2,100 Metres

The Top Mountain Motorcycle Museum at the Timmelsjoch toll station in Hochgurgl is considered the highest motorcycle museum in Europe. In the architecturally striking curved timber building, technology enthusiasts will find one of the most valuable two-wheeler collections in the world.

Racing Rarities and Panoramic Alpine Views

More than 500 historic machines from all major eras and brands are meticulously curated here. Alongside legendary motorcycles, rare vintage cars and historic race cars document the fascinating evolution of alpine mobility.
